role: Associate Planner, North Dakota State Intergovernmental Clearinghouse
stance_basis: transmits A-95 clearinghouse comments from state agencies without expressing personal position
summary: Bonnie E. Austin, as Associate Planner for the North Dakota State Intergovernmental Clearinghouse, submitted a formal letter transmitting attached comments from the State Highway Department and State Forest Service in compliance with OMB Circular No. A-95. Her letter is procedural in nature, forwarding the state agencies' substantive comments rather than expressing her own position on the proposed ORV regulations. The attached agency comments request that the implementation directive explicitly provide for authorized state and local government land survey and emergency vehicles, and that USDI lands be opened to off-road vehicles.
complaint_summary: Bonnie E. Austin transmits the North Dakota State Intergovernmental Clearinghouse's formal A-95 review comment, forwarding attached comments from the State Highway Department and State Forest Service requesting that the implementation directive explicitly provide for authorized state and local government land survey and emergency vehicles.

statement.text:
Dear Mr. Morton:
Subject: Draft Environmental Impact Statement regarding implementation of Executive Order 11644 which provides for the control of use of off-road vehicles on public lands. This draft document would establish implementation procedures.
This application was received in our office on June 14, 1972.
In the process of the A-95 review, the attached comments were received from the State Highway Department and the State Forest Service.
This document and attachments constitute the comment of the State Intergovernmental Clearinghouse, made in compliance with OMB Circular No. A-95.
Sincerely yours,
Miss Bonnie E. Austin
